title: Reflect privacy pool
description: A short statement set big (72px gradient heading) in a wide oval pool of violet light, with a glowing 100px round emblem above its badge, a two-line muted lead and one dark button. The pool fades in as it enters the window.
notes: media is the glowing field behind (a scrambled-text video, 1568×882 in the original) and emblem the round padlock; empty, a glow wash and a violet disc
name: reflect-privacy
